## Role in the Rating Process

The World Bank has a limited direct role for euro-area sovereigns in the minimal rating process. It serves as a source of global macroeconomic and debt statistics.

## Evidence by Country

### [Bulgaria](../countries/bulgaria.qmd)

- Referenced for studies on the impact of political favoritism on public procurement. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/country-reports/Bulgaria_2026-06-03, p. 12" aria-label="Source: ec/country-reports/Bulgaria_2026-06-03, p. 12">ⓘ</button>
- Referenced for estimates of the shadow economy. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/country-reports/Bulgaria_2026-06-03, p. 57" aria-label="Source: ec/country-reports/Bulgaria_2026-06-03, p. 57">ⓘ</button>

### [Greece](../countries/greece.qmd)

- Cited for the 2025 Business Ready report, which highlights low operational efficiency of public services for businesses. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/country-reports/Greece_2026-06-03, p. 5, p. 53" aria-label="Source: ec/country-reports/Greece_2026-06-03, p. 5, p. 53">ⓘ</button>
